1	# SuperGrok2
2	
3	A grokking-optimizer + model training stack built as **44 reusable components
4	that compose into 99 fused training pipelines** across three accelerator
5	families — **NVIDIA sm_90 (Hopper)**, **AMD gfx942 (CDNA3 / MI300X)**, and
6	**Google TPU v6e** — with **one canonical source of truth per component**
7	(no parallel math trees, no dead duplicates; enforced by a self-test drift
8	guard).
9	
10	> **Status honesty.** Everything below is **implemented and system-verified on
11	> this environment via CPU / clang-AMDGPU-gate / `nvcc -c` / JAX-lowering**.
12	> No accelerator is present here, so all *runtime* and *numeric-parity* claims
13	> are 🟡 and gated on the executable checklist in
14	> [`HARDWARE_VALIDATION.md`](HARDWARE_VALIDATION.md) (H100 / MI300X / TPU v6e).
15	> Nothing in this README claims a hardware result.
16	
17	---
18	
19	## 1. The 44 → 99 architecture
20	
21	**44 components**, each with exactly one canonical home:
22	
23	| component group | count | canonical home |
24	|-----------------|------:|----------------|
25	| optimizer × arch | 11 × 3 = 33 | per-arch (below) |
26	| model × arch | 3 × 3 = 9 | per-arch (below) |
27	| dispatch + compile | 2 | `csrc/fused/` + `grokking_optimizers/megakernel*.py` |
28	
29	**11 optimizers:** AdamW, Lion, Grokfast, GrokAdamW, LookSAM, Prodigy,
30	NeuralGrok, Muon, SuperGrok1.1, SuperGrok1.5, SuperGrok2.
31	**3 models:** Transformer-Decoder, ViT, Mamba-3.
32	**3 archs:** sm_90, gfx942, tpu_v6e.
33	
34	The **dispatch/compile layer composes any optimizer component with any model
35	component** into one fused L3/L1 persistent megakernel per (model, optimizer,
36	arch) → **99 pipelines**. Each cell is a *real composition* of the canonical
37	component device-functions — there are **no template wrappers, no demo
38	includes** (anti-false-positive sweep = 0).
39	
40	### Canonical directory layout (one source per component)
41	
42	```
43	csrc/algorithms/<opt>.h            ← CANONICAL per-element optimizer math (CUDA),
44	                                      ONE definition per optimizer. The SG2
45	                                      bilevel adjoint lives in
46	                                      supergrok2_bilevel_adjoint.h.
47	                                      SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md documents the contract.
48	
49	grokking_optimizers/kernels/
50	  sm_90/<opt>_sm90.cuh             ← per-op LAUNCH wrapper (#includes the
51	                                      canonical header; zero math duplication)
52	  sm_90/<model>_sm90.cuh           ← CANONICAL CUDA model (CUTLASS Sm90 TMA/WGMMA)
53	  gfx942/<opt|model>_gfx942.hip.hpp← CANONICAL AMDGCN device kernels (MFMA/DPP +
54	                                      f32x4-vectorized apply-steps)
55	  (there is NO kernels/tpu/ tree — the canonical TPU path is pallas, below)
56	
57	csrc/backends/
58	  cuda/sm_90/*.cu                  ← pure entry-point shims (~5 LOC, #include only)
59	  hip/gfx942/*.hip.cpp             ← entry points + amdgcn_primitives + SG2
60	                                      device adjoint + MoE compaction
61	  pallas/launch_<opt>.py           ← CANONICAL TPU/JAX math for ALL 11 optimizers
62	  pallas/_pallas_models.py         ← CANONICAL TPU model fwd/bwd (decoder/vit/mamba)
63	  pallas/_pallas_fused.py          ← composes the 33 TPU fused cells
64	
65	csrc/fused/
66	  sm_90/opt_components.cuh         ← apply_optimizer<OptId> → csrc/algorithms
67	  sm_90/model_stages.cuh           ← element-local model fwd/bwd
68	  sm_90/fused_megakernel.cuh       ← the composition seam (L3/L1 persistent kernel)
69	  gfx942/{opt_components,model_stages,fused_megakernel}.hip.hpp
70	  {sm_90,gfx942,tpu_v6e}/mega_<model>_<opt>.{cu,hip,py}  ← the 99 real cells
71	  megakernel_common*.{cuh,hip.hpp} ← task queue, %smid/HW_ID pin, GridBarrier
72	```
73	
74	**Single-source guarantee (enforced).** The CUDA per-op path and the fused path
75	both `#include` `csrc/algorithms/<opt>.h` and CALL its step function — they
76	cannot drift. The enforced guard `scripts/check_math_single_source.py` (wired
77	into `--self-test` as `math_drift_guard`) *fails the build* on three triggers:
78	(1) a consumer stops `#include`-ing the canonical header; (2) a consumer keeps
79	the include but **re-inlines** the Adam moment-update/apply locally (Phase-7
80	re-inline detection — catches the subtle case where math is re-typed in the
81	`.cuh`); (3) the canonical math changes without a deliberate `--update-manifest`
82	(content-hash manifest). The gfx942 device transcription and the TPU JAX path
83	are documented, cross-referenced re-expressions (necessary: thrust/JAX toolchain
84	constraints), covered by the manifest. The C++ fused dispatch table is
85	generator-emitted (`csrc/fused/fused_wired_cells.inc`) from the same solver
86	enumeration that emits the 99 cells, so it cannot hand-sync-drift.
87	
88	---
89	
90	## 2. Per-arch story
91	
92	- **sm_90 (Hopper):** inlined PTX in the owning headers (`rsqrt.approx`,
93	  `ex2.approx`, `fma.rn`, `redux.sync`, …); **CUTLASS Sm90 collectives**
94	  (TMA + WGMMA) for the model GEMMs, with a **TF32 (`tfloat32_t`) tensor-core
95	  path** for FP32 (scalar fallback only for untileable shapes, or forced via
96	  `-DSG_FORCE_SCALAR_FP32`); warp-specialized producer/consumer register split
97	  (`setmaxnreg`) in the fused megakernel; L2-persistence + cluster/DSMEM
98	  helpers.
99	- **gfx942 (CDNA3 / MI300X):** hand-written **AMDGCN** device kernels —
100	  `__builtin_amdgcn_mfma_*` (bf16 16×16) for Muon Newton-Schulz + SG2 PEER/attn,
101	  **DPP wave-64 reductions** for the reducing optimizers (LookSAM/Prodigy/Muon/
102	  SG1.1/SG1.5), FNUZ FP8, `buffer_load`→LDS, `sched_group_barrier` interleave.
103	  The device kernels are the **LIVE path on a hipcc build** (`#if __HIPCC__` →
104	  `hipLaunchKernelGGL`); ATen/rocBLAS is the `#else` **CPU fallback**. The SG2
105	  gfx942 bilevel adjoint + MoE compaction are real AMDGCN device code.
106	- **tpu_v6e:** **Pallas** programs (`pl.pallas_call` + `BlockSpec`) composed by
107	  `_pallas_fused.py` into one `jax.jit` fused program per cell (splash-attention
108	  where available, hand-tiled dense fallback otherwise; `lax.associative_scan`
109	  for Mamba).
110	
111	---
112	
113	## 3. Fused-megakernel substrate + feasibility solver
114	
115	One persistent kernel (one CTA per SM/CU) runs **forward → grid-barrier →
116	backward → grid-barrier → optimizer** in a single launch, over a global
117	task-queue with `%smid`/`HW_ID` SM-pinning and a hand-built sense-reversing
118	GridBarrier. The feasibility solver (`grokking_optimizers/megakernel.py`,
119	`solve_all`) picks the highest fusion tier that fits each arch's register/smem
120	budget:
121	
122	- **L3** (fwd+bwd+opt fused), **L1** (optimizer-only fused).
123	- Current solver assignment: **77 / 99 L3, 22 / 99 L1** (after the Phase-4
124	  register pass: SMEM staging + rematerialization + the `setmaxnreg` warp-group
125	  split). 🟡 **These tiers are estimates** — `ptxas -v` / `rocm-llvm` on real
126	  silicon is the arbiter; the per-cell `maxrregcount` autotuner sweep in
127	  `compile.py` selects the winner on hardware.
128	
129	The 99 cells are generated by `grokking_optimizers/megakernel_codegen.py`
130	(`--emit <model> <optimizer> <arch>` / `--write-all`); cell header comments
131	(tier/reg/smem) are generator-emitted from the live solver so they cannot drift.
132	
133	---
134	
135	## 4. Distributed training
136	
137	`grokking_optimizers/distributed.py`: 3D parallelism (`ParallelConfig` +
138	`DistributedContext`, Megatron-style DP×TP×PP rank mesh with TP innermost) +
139	**ZeRO-3** sharding (DeepSpeed-or-native shim) over **NCCL (NVIDIA) / RCCL
140	(AMD)**. All `torch.distributed` access is guarded → a single-rank run is a
141	no-op with no collective launch. The fused step integrates via
142	`megakernel_engine.py` (the `FusedBackwardHook` / `MegakernelOptimizer` adapter
143	that reconciles the fused L3 launch with the framework's separate
144	fwd/bwd/`step()` contract).
145	
146	---
147	
148	## 5. Build
149	
150	```bash
151	# NVIDIA (Hopper), with CUTLASS Sm90 collectives:
152	git submodule update --init third_party/cutlass
153	FORCE_CUDA=1 WITH_CUTLASS=1 TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST="9.0a" \
154	  pip install -e . --no-build-isolation
155	
156	# AMD (MI300X):
157	WITH_HIP=1 pip install -e . --no-build-isolation     # requires ROCm/hipcc
158	
159	# TPU v6e:
160	pip install "jax[tpu]" -f https://storage.googleapis.com/jax-releases/libtpu_releases.html
161	
162	# CPU-only (host build; device paths take their ATen/JAX fallbacks):
163	pip install -e . --no-build-isolation
164	```
165	
166	`setup.py` resolves the source set per configuration (verified 0-missing /
167	0-dangling): WITH_CUDA = 49 sources, WITH_HIP = 46 sources (each incl. the 33
168	fused cells).
169	
170	---
171	
172	## 6. Verification (this environment — no accelerator)
173	
174	```bash
175	# The end-all-be-all: prove the modular composition compiles AND runs maximally.
176	python -m grokking_optimizers.verify_all                # 152/152, all phases
177	python -m grokking_optimizers.verify_all --phase 4      # just MAXIMALITY (fast)
178	python -m grokking_optimizers.verify_all --quick        # skip the 99 compiles
179	
180	# Full-scale binary profiling: prove the emitted machine code is MAXIMAL.
181	python -m grokking_optimizers.profile_maximal           # 17/17, all tiers
182	python -m grokking_optimizers.profile_maximal --quick   # tier D (functional) only
183	
184	# The individual gates verify_all orchestrates:
185	python -m grokking_optimizers.compile --self-test     # 156 passed, 0 failed
186	ruff check grokking_optimizers/ && ruff format --check grokking_optimizers/
187	python scripts/check_math_single_source.py            # drift guard (exit 0)
188	scripts/amdgcn_check.sh --header <gfx942 header>       # clang AMDGPU device gate
189	scripts/amdgcn_check.sh --cell <gfx942 mega_*.hip>     # full composed-cell gate
190	scripts/compile_to_object.sh <tu>.cu -DWITH_CUTLASS    # nvcc -c sm_90a
191	```
192	
193	**`verify_all` is the single authoritative gate.** It runs six phases: (0)
194	toolchain probe, (1) structural inventory, (2) single-component compile gates,
195	(3) **MODULAR COMPOSITION** — every optimizer compiles *together with* every
196	model across all **99 fused cells** (33 sm_90 via `nvcc -c`, 33 gfx942 via the
197	AMDGCN device gate, 33 tpu_v6e via `jax` trace+lower), (4) **MAXIMALITY** —
198	every cell at its max feasible fusion tier, codegen idempotency (all 99 cells
199	byte-identical to the generator), register+smem budget, math single-source
200	drift, (5) cross-validation — dispatch tables match their generators, self-test,
201	ruff, the utilization crash-hard contract. Anything needing absent hardware is
202	reported `SKIP-silicon`, never a false green.
203
